Guides / Battle & team / Moves & the Move Tutor

Moves & the Move Tutor

Auto-picked moves, pins, Catchers and the Move Tutor's prices.

Every Pokémon learns moves by level (its level-up list, like the games) and auto-picks its 4 strongest damaging ones: power × accuracy, ×1.5 for its own type, charge/recharge moves less, and repeat types count less so it keeps coverage. Pin a move to always keep it.

Catchers

A Pokémon that knows False Swipe, Hold Back, a sleep or paralysis move, or Nuzzle is a Catcher: when the team wants to catch something, it steps in from the bench, puts it to sleep or paralyses it, and False Swipes it to 1 HP. Pin those moves on a teammate.

Move Tutor

From a Pokémon's moves panel, pay the Move Tutor to teach a TM / tutor move it can learn. Taught moves stay in its pool for good (and pass on through Inherit). Smeargle can learn every move in the game. Prices go from $2,000 for weak moves to $40,000 for the strongest: catch moves (False Swipe / Hold Back $5,000, sleep and paralysis moves $4,000) stay cheap, other status moves cost $3,000.

In the Move Tutor list, the category icons show only Physical, Special or Status moves, and the sort "Physical / Special / Status" groups them. Big buys (over $20,000) ask first; tick "Don't show again" to skip the question (the bell next to your money in the Mart brings it back).

The price of every move is on the Moves list.
